bio.text: Ron Kim has represented the 40th Assembly District in Flushing, Queens, since his election in 2012.

Before the Assembly he worked in the offices of City Councilmember John C. Liu and Assemblyman Mark Weprin, as a policy analyst for Council Speaker Christine Quinn, and from 2007 to 2010 as a regional director in the Spitzer and Paterson administrations.
He holds a B.A. from Hamilton College and a Master of Public Administration from Baruch College, and lives in Flushing.
